description: Validates current-build motion, evidence completeness, resource budget, profile durability, cancellation/recovery, and passive-fidelity owner receipts against the BAS rehabilitation bands.

notApplicableKinds.reason: Profile storage durability is a browser scenario behavior and cannot apply to control-plane targets.

determinism.reason: The phase validates motion, evidence-completeness, resource-budget, profile, cancellation, and passive-fidelity owner receipts against source, contract, and live managed build identity.

capabilities.label: Evidence completeness
capabilities.description: Artifact failures remain explicit and retained evidence is attributable and hash-verifiable across screenshot, telemetry, external video/trace and retention boundaries.

levels.name: Unavailable
levels.description: No valid current-build artifact-integrity owner receipt is available.
exit_criteria: The focused screenshot failure, inline console/network snapshot failure, external video/trace storage fault, and active-retention protection owners pass with current source/build digests and hashed raw test logs.

levels.name: Verified
levels.description: All focused artifact-integrity and retention owners pass with current source/build digests and retained raw test logs.
entry_criteria: The focused screenshot failure, inline console/network snapshot failure, external video/trace storage fault, and active-retention protection owners pass with current source/build digests and hashed raw test logs.

capabilities.label: Profile durability
capabilities.description: Synthetic browser profile state survives close/reopen and managed service restart with isolation intact.

levels.name: Unavailable
levels.description: No valid current-build owner receipt is available.
exit_criteria: Owner receipts match source and contract hashes and the live build.

levels.name: Verified
levels.description: The current candidate passed the declared profile durability cohort.
entry_criteria: Owner receipts match source and contract hashes and the live build.

capabilities.label: Cancellation and recovery
capabilities.description: Accepted cancellation stops input promptly, terminal cleanup and session recovery meet the declared bands, and uncertain side effects are not replayed.

levels.name: Unavailable
levels.description: No valid current-build cancellation/recovery owner receipt is available.
exit_criteria: All five timeout/cancel/death/restart/retry fixture cases pass within the declared bands and match source/contract/build identity.

levels.name: Verified
levels.description: The current candidate passed all five independent cancellation/recovery fixture cases.
entry_criteria: All five timeout/cancel/death/restart/retry fixture cases pass within the declared bands and match source/contract/build identity.

capabilities.label: Passive fidelity
capabilities.description: Acknowledged browser observations are retained once, in order, through the managed API journal, crash/reconnect, and core browser event semantics.

levels.name: Unavailable
levels.description: A current managed cohort, crash/reconnect owner, or browser semantics receipt is missing, stale, or invalid.
exit_criteria: At least10,000 managed fixture actions have exact independent effects, unique ordered journal identities, and applied-input receipts with zero primary-storage writes; crash/reconnect retains one same-ID event; core input/navigation semantics pass on current source and build.

levels.name: Verified
levels.description: The managed10,000-action cohort, process crash/reconnect fault, and current browser semantics cases all pass with source and contract digests validated.
entry_criteria: At least10,000 managed fixture actions have exact independent effects, unique ordered journal identities, and applied-input receipts with zero primary-storage writes; crash/reconnect retains one same-ID event; core input/navigation semantics pass on current source and build.

capabilities.label: Resource budget
capabilities.description: A managed Linux idle cohort stays within the API/driver PSS and CPU bands, a local fixture browser and shell stay within their memory band, and Windows private-memory status is reported separately.

levels.name: Unavailable
levels.description: No valid current-build resource-budget cohort is available.
exit_criteria: A 60-second idle owner sample matches the current build and sources; API+driver PSS is at most 300 MiB, idle CPU average and p95 are below 2% of one core, a fixture browser plus shell is at most 1 GiB PSS, and Windows private-memory status is reported separately.

levels.name: Verified
levels.description: The managed Linux idle and fixture-browser resource cohort meets the declared bands with Windows comparison status explicit.
entry_criteria: A 60-second idle owner sample matches the current build and sources; API+driver PSS is at most 300 MiB, idle CPU average and p95 are below 2% of one core, a fixture browser plus shell is at most 1 GiB PSS, and Windows private-memory status is reported separately.

capabilities.label: Sustained live motion
capabilities.description: A changing fixture streams at 30 FPS through the managed driver, API relay and viewer canvas for five minutes; frame age and decode remain bounded and a deliberately slow viewer does not accumulate work.

levels.name: Unavailable
levels.description: No valid current-build five-minute motion and slow-reader receipt is available.
exit_criteria: A current managed motion receipt proves at least 30 rendered FPS for five minutes, p95 frame age at most 100 ms, bounded frame bytes/decode, and a slow-reader cohort with one active decode and bounded frame age/bytes.

levels.name: Verified
levels.description: The current candidate meets the sustained motion and slow-reader bands through the real API relay and viewer canvas.
entry_criteria: A current managed motion receipt proves at least 30 rendered FPS for five minutes, p95 frame age at most 100 ms, bounded frame bytes/decode, and a slow-reader cohort with one active decode and bounded frame age/bytes.

EVIDENCE_COMPLETENESS_INVALID.reason: Missing, stale or failed screenshot, console/network, external artifact or active-retention owner evidence requires the focused BAS artifact-integrity cohort.

PROFILE_EVIDENCE_INVALID.reason: Stale or failed behavioral evidence requires rerunning the managed profile durability cohort.

CANCELLATION_EVIDENCE_INVALID.reason: Missing, stale, or out-of-band owner evidence requires the focused BAS cancellation/recovery qualification.

PASSIVE_FIDELITY_EVIDENCE_INVALID.reason: Missing, stale, or out-of-band managed journal, crash/reconnect, or browser event-semantics evidence requires its focused BAS owner.

RESOURCE_BUDGET_EVIDENCE_INVALID.reason: Missing, stale, or out-of-band idle process, fixture-browser, or Windows comparison evidence requires the focused resource owner.

MOTION_EVIDENCE_INVALID.reason: Missing, stale, or out-of-band sustained frame-age, throughput, byte, decode, or slow-reader evidence requires the focused BAS motion owner.
